question: Estimate the AUM of Indian mutual fund industry by 2030.
idealClarificationQuestions: Total industry AUM (equity + debt + hybrid + passive)? Yes.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Frame the approach
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Growth from current base + investor base expansion.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: - Market appreciation (assuming 11-13% nominal returns): ~10% YoY on existing.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: AUM by FY30 (4 years out): ₹70L Cr × 1.18^4 = ~₹1.36 lakh Cr × 1 = ₹135-140 lakh Cr.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Penetration: AUM/GDP would rise from ~17% (today) to ~25% (still below US 80%+).

benchmarkAssumptions.value: AUM/GDP would rise from ~17% (today) to ~25% (still below US 80%+).

calculationFlow: - SIP inflows: ~₹3 lakh Cr/year and rising.
- New investor additions: ~1 crore new folios per year.
AUM by FY30 (4 years out): ₹70L Cr × 1.18^4 = ~₹1.36 lakh Cr × 1 = ₹135-140 lakh Cr.
Round: ~₹130-140 lakh Cr ($16-17 trillion) by FY30.
Penetration: AUM/GDP would rise from ~17% (today) to ~25% (still below US 80%+).
